text.Körperliche Entwicklung und bewusster Se: Physical development and a conscious relationship with yourself belong together. Two equally valid starting points — together we discuss what suits your goals.
text.Dich ausrichten. Vertrauen entwickeln. D: Find your direction. Develop confidence. Put your abilities into action.
text.Verletzung oder Sportpause, Wiedereinsti: An injury or break from sport, returning to training, a competition or an exam? Together we find a suitable approach.
text.Körperlich stärker werden. Bewusster mit: Become physically stronger. Develop a more conscious relationship with yourself.
text.Kraft aufbauen, Ausdauer ausbauen, Koord: Build strength and endurance, develop coordination and mobility.
text.Ich begleite dich so, wie du es brauchst: I support you in the way you need.
text.Möchtest du dich im Alltag oder Sport kr: Would you like to feel stronger and more mobile in everyday life or sport — or return to regular training after a break?
text.Wir stimmen das Training auf deine Ziele: We adapt training to your goals, experience and everyday life. Together we practise suitable movements, pay attention to how your body feels and discuss training load and recovery.
text.Auf Wunsch können wir uns auf Yoga oder: If you wish, we can focus on yoga or self-defence.
text.Bei Bedarf können wir die Begleitung dur: If needed, we can add support by phone or video call. We agree on the scope and arrangements personally in advance.
text.Nach einer Verletzung oder längeren Spor: After an injury or a longer break from sport, we take medical guidance and any required clearance into account. Personal training does not replace medical treatment or rehabilitation.
text.Verletzung oder Sportpause?: An injury or a break from sport?
text.Fehlt dir nach einer Verletzung oder Spo: Are you missing a sense of direction or confidence in your body after an injury or break from sport?
text.Gemeinsam erkunden wir den Umgang mit de: Together we explore how to deal with the changed situation, clarify realistic goals and focus on what you can influence now. Medical guidance remains the basis.
text.Wieder einsteigen und Vertrauen entwicke: Return to sport and develop confidence
text.Halten dich beim Wiedereinstieg Zweifel: Do doubts or fear of another injury hold you back when returning to sport?
text.Wettkampf, Prüfung oder wichtige Leistun: A competition, exam or important performance situation?
text.Kreisen deine Gedanken um das Ergebnis,: Do your thoughts circle around the result, possible mistakes, fear of failure or how others might judge you — rather than your next action? Do you then struggle to show what you have practised?
text.Wirst du in wichtigen Momenten hektisch: Do you become restless in important moments, or struggle to get going?
text.Je nach Situation geht es darum, herunte: Depending on the situation, the aim may be to settle down or get going.
text.Bringen dich Fehler, Rückschläge oder un: Do mistakes, setbacks or unexpected changes throw you off balance?
text.Startest du motiviert – und verlierst na: Do you start out motivated — and lose track after a short time?
text.Hast du Ziele, weißt aber nicht, welche: Do you have goals but feel unsure which exercises and training load suit you?
text.Wir beziehen Anstrengung, Atem und Körpe: We take exertion, breathing and how your body feels into account. Together we explore when a challenge fits and when a break is appropriate.
text.Fühlt sich Training nur noch wie eine Pf: Does training feel like just another obligation?
text.Spannst du bei einer Aufgabe unnötig an,: Do you tense up unnecessarily during a task, hold your breath or become rushed?
text.Wir erproben einen passenden Fokus, eine: We try an appropriate focus, a change in technique or a break. Body awareness and suitable breathing exercises complement movement.
text.Fehlt dir nach einer Verletzung mehr als: After an injury, do you miss more than movement — your outlet, daily structure or sense of belonging? Do you wonder what remains of your sporting identity? Do frustration, impatience or worries about the future take up a lot of space?
text.Wir klären, was dir am Sport wichtig ist: We clarify what matters to you about sport and what can still have a place now: connection with others, daily structure or achievable personal goals. We explore frustration and repetitive thoughts, then choose a next step that suits your situation and limits.
text.Gemeinsam erproben wir eine persönliche: Together we try personal preparation, helpful self-talk and a brief focus on the next action you can influence. Relevant information from outside remains part of the task.
text.Diese persönlichen Erfahrungen stammen a: These personal experiences relate to previous general support.
text.Ich weiß genau, was ich tun kann, wenn m: I know exactly what I can do when my stress level gets out of control again — I haven't had a panic attack in a long time. My son asked me recently: "Mom, what did you do to yourself? You're much less grumpy now." And even a friend said: "How do you manage to stay so calm when the kids are being difficult?"
text.Dank dem Humor von Herrn Wiertelorz konn: Thanks to Mr. Wiertelorz's humor, I was able to reconnect with my inner child. Staying active now comes easily, because together we could figure out which form of activity I enjoy. My son is very happy that I now regularly take him to the playground to shoot some hoops and play basketball together.
text.Als ich zu Philipp gekommen bin, war ich: When I came to Philipp, I was internally quite scattered, restless, and habitually in a fight with myself and the outside world — constantly in resistance. Through the body training and the conscious return to the current task, I have found more and more of myself. Meanwhile I often come to rest automatically in everyday life and am at peace with myself. That was unthinkable before.
text.Wir besprechen, welche Fragen und Aufgab: We discuss which questions and tasks are suitable for support by phone or video call.
text.Ist der Tag oder das Training vorbei, ab: Is the day or training session over, but your mind and body remain tense? We begin with a guided, comfortable breathing exercise and your own perception.
text.Atemübung und HRV im Detail: Breathing exercise and HRV in detail
text.Dein Anliegen und unsere Zusammenarbeit: Your concerns and how we work together
text.Kraft, Mobilität und Koordination traini: Train strength, mobility and coordination. Use breathing and stillness to explore tension, settling down and getting going.
text.Kommen Bewegung und Erholung im vollen A: Does a busy everyday life leave too little room for movement and recovery? Would you like to start again after a longer break? Are you unsure about exercises or training load?
text.Ich erkläre und zeige die Bewegung, beob: I explain and demonstrate the movement, observe your technique and give specific feedback. Together we adapt range of motion, resistance, pace and breaks to your training level, how you feel that day and your feedback.
text.Wir finden einen machbaren Einstieg. Wen: We find a manageable starting point. If you wish, we choose additional exercises for home or everyday life, even when the week does not go as planned.
text.Möchtest du schon wieder trainieren, obw: Do you already want to train again even though you do not feel recovered yet?
text.Wir suchen Aufgaben, bei denen auch Spie: We look for activities that leave room for play, ambition and ease. Together we find out which tasks suit you and adapt them to you.
text.Wie häufig wir gemeinsam trainieren, sti: We adapt how often we train together to your goals, training level and everyday life. If you wish, we choose additional exercises for between sessions.
text.Wir besprechen, was sich gut umsetzen lä: We discuss what is manageable and adapt the plan as needed.
text.Fällt es dir nach Training oder einem vo: Is it hard to settle down after training or a busy day?
text.Wir erproben eine angenehme Atemübung un: We try a comfortable breathing exercise and pay attention to how you feel. If you wish, we add HRV biofeedback: a chest strap records your heartbeats and we look at the feedback on screen. Together we discuss what you notice during the exercise.
text.Wenn du möchtest, ergänzen wir HRV-Biofe: If you wish, we add HRV biofeedback: a chest strap records your heartbeats and we look at the feedback on screen together. We discuss what you notice and how the exercise suits you.
text.Herzratenvariabilität (HRV) beschreibt d: Heart rate variability (HRV) describes differences in the time intervals between heartbeats. Your pulse counts heartbeats per minute. Blood pressure describes the pressure in your blood vessels. These are different measurements.
text.Davon getrennt können wiederholte Messun: Separately, repeated measurements at rest can show your personal trend over several days. We consider them alongside sleep, training load, recovery and how your body feels, and discuss how this information relates to your training week.
text.Davon getrennt betrachten wir bei Bedarf: Separately, if relevant, we look at repeated resting measurements over several days alongside sleep, training load, recovery and how your body feels. Together we discuss what you would like to observe more closely in your everyday life.
text.Wir wählen einen angenehmen Atemrhythmus: We choose a comfortable breathing rhythm. If you feel dizzy or unwell, we stop the exercise and you return to your usual breathing rhythm.
text.Bei gesundheitlichen Einschränkungen ber: If you have health-related limitations, we take medical guidance into account. If symptoms are new or worsening, we stop and clarify how to proceed.
text.Wir schauen auf die Worte, die du dir se: We look at the words you say to yourself and how you say them. We explore your state of mind alongside practical steps. Together we develop and try new patterns and routines.
text.Gemeinsam klären wir, was dich verunsich: Together we clarify what makes you uncertain and choose suitable mental exercises, such as mentally preparing a movement or trying helpful self-talk.
text.Was verunsichert dich beim Wiedereinstie: What makes you uncertain about returning, and what physical activity is already permitted? We clarify your concerns and choose suitable mental exercises. For example, you might mentally prepare an upcoming movement or find words that support your return. Together we try what suits your situation.
text.Für die körperliche Rückkehr in den Spor: Medical guidance applies to the physical return to sport. If exercise is medically prohibited, we do not add physical training load.
text.Gemeinsam wählen wir, woran du arbeiten: Together we choose what you would like to work on and try suitable exercises for your preparation and focus.
text.Deinen Zustand wahrnehmen und passend ak: Notice your state and find the right level of activation
text.Gemeinsam wählen und erproben wir Atem-,: Together we choose and try breathing, movement, attention and other self-regulation exercises. You practise noticing your activation level — how tense, alert or ready you feel — and influencing it to suit the situation.
text.Wir beziehen deine Grenzen, passende Pau: We take your boundaries, suitable breaks and helpful support into account as you work on confidence and resilience.
text.Wie häufig Begleitung sinnvoll ist, besp: We discuss together how often support would be useful. If needed, we add a phone or video call; we agree on the scope and arrangements in advance.
text.Wir wählen Übungen passend zu deinem Anl: We choose exercises to suit your concerns and try them together. If you wish, we agree on small routines for between sessions. Your experiences help us adapt the exercises. Joy, ease and ambition have a place here.
text.Wir wählen passende Inhalte und besprech: We choose suitable content and discuss how often support would be useful. Additional independent practice is optional and agreed together.
